scope: CPU generated-data full objective short training and state replay only; no patient/server/GPU.

protocol.selection: final fixed optimizer step only; no validation or test selection
protocol.input_generation: fixed XOR / continuous P=G=Z, risk from Z² / null; original 2 signals augmented with independent nuisance path patches and RNA
protocol.censor_generation: independent end-of-bin censoring with administrative final-bin censoring
protocol.train_rng: same seed and epoch-specific torch seed and view_seed in both arms
protocol.auxiliaries: all original 11 plus all 4 dense terms enabled and raw terms/diagnostics recorded per step
protocol.candidate: pathology-only learned query regions supply ONLY token-cooperation pathology input; old RNA-conditioned predictions and direct head remain
protocol.candidate_extra_io: candidate uses a separate pathology-only streaming pass; measured reads include checkpoint backward replays
protocol.calibration_caveat: oracle survival error uses synthetic true hazard; training alpha=.5 weights censored rows less than ordinary likelihood

limits: Five optimizer steps and small generated data check actual wiring only; validation and fresh NLL are not converged model performance.
Not a PID estimator or proof of identified synergy, disentanglement, or biological meaning.
The prior RNA-conditioned prediction branch remains in BOTH models.
No padding in these generated cases; existing unit tests address padding separately.
The two models use same initial parameter values and 15-term configuration, but candidate has extra pathology forward pass and distinct gradients.
Auxiliary enabled does not establish estimability; per-term measured/unknown diagnostics are recorded.
No patient data, clinical generalization or GPU evidence.
